sources.title: ceselder/skip-lens-qwen36-27b-cnla-rl · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Part of the skip-lens project — multi-token natural-language activation lenses on Qwen3.6-27B. A skip-lens takes a single residual-stream activation and decodes, in natural language, what the model is about to say — and for intermediate layers, surfaces the model's workspace content.
